notes: Days like today stops being a dead end. Tap a row and it opens in place with its own actions — full history, deep dive, report, watchlist, practice buy — so you never lose the list to look at one share. If you do open a full history there is now a back button that returns you to the list exactly as it was. A find box and sort buttons (odds, median, events) were added, sorting by events matters because 63/100 on 1,904 days and 60/100 on 2,744 days are not the same quality of evidence. And shares wearing the same fingerprint today are tagged shared look: three rows showing identical numbers are one pattern, not three findings.
